source_anchor: Shazeer et al. 2017 "Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer" §3; Fedus Zoph Shazeer 2022 "Switch Transformer" §2.2
prompt_text: Mixture-of-experts top-k gating: given gate_logits = [1.2, 0.5, 2.1, 0.3] and top_k = 2, return the top-2 expert indices sorted by score descending (largest first). Print as a JSON array.

exec_cell.code: const logits=[1.2,0.5,2.1,0.3]; const k=2; const idx=logits.map((v,i)=>({v,i})).sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v).slice(0,k).map(o=>o.i); console.log(JSON.stringify(idx));

candidate_responses.text: CORRECT: uses Array.prototype.keys() + sort by gate[idx] descending, slice top_k.
candidate_responses.code: const gate=[1.2,0.5,2.1,0.3]; const top_k=2; const ranked=[...gate.keys()].sort((a,b)=>gate[b]-gate[a]).slice(0,top_k); console.log(JSON.stringify(ranked));

candidate_responses.text: WRONG: sorts ascending (bottom-k) instead of descending (top-k).
CARGO-CULT: gate_logits / top_k / sort descending — but returns the top-k SCORES not their indices.
candidate_responses.code: const gate_logits=[1.2,0.5,2.1,0.3]; const top_k=2; const top_scores=gate_logits.slice().sort((a,b)=>b-a).slice(0,top_k); console.log(JSON.stringify(top_scores));
